meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: 它会先喊出 HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED，然后召集团队模式下 5 个互相敌对的成员（怀疑者、验证者、研究者、架构师、创意者）对计划交叉批驳，只留下经得住攻击的洞见，再强制交给 plan 代理整理成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出 hyperplan、hpp、/hyperplan 等触发词，或要求以对抗/敌意模式做计划时触发；须开启团队模式，以 sisyphus 或其他可带队代理在主会话运行。

say.text: hyperplan：用对抗模式规划产品发布计划
say.note: 组建 5 人对抗团队相互批判。

say.text: hpp：批判我的架构方案，找出弱假设
say.note: 会攻击过度工程和拍脑袋结论。

say.text: hyperplan：帮我规划跨部门路线图，最终要能落地的执行版本
say.note: 最后交给 plan 代理整理成执行计划。

howto.what_en: Claude spawns 5 adversarial members via team mode to cross-critique the plan, keeps only defensible insights, then hands them to the plan agent to formalize an executable plan. It first announces HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention hyperplan, hpp, /hyperplan, or ask for adversarial/hostile planning. Requires team-mode enabled, running as sisyphus (or another lead-eligible agent) in the main session.

say_en.text: hyperplan: plan the product launch with adversarial mode.
hpp: critique my architecture design for weak assumptions.
hyperplan: plan the cross-team roadmap and finalize a deployable plan.
say_en.note: Final plan is written by the plan agent.
